<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election schedules announced:</strong> The Election Commission of India has scheduled polls for 37 Rajya Sabha seats across 10 states for March 16, alongside bye-elections for five Assembly seats and one Lok Sabha seat set for October 6.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOb0gtZThDOFJYTm0wUzloLTVRZm53TG1MRm9yaUx2dk8yRFc2YVdxYmNIbEhSSk8tS0U5OElfczhRWmhNT1BVb1VsVkhNYzVKM2haaUR0dHRSZFlFMk1HWmM1QWhRX1lLYkJlbExMYTBBQmRaMGpKbnRwWUpjRXVmUHVQRlV6dHRmQjI3SUw5X2Z1R1hLRUtycVdmdWprRnM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQaE9UTTJEazdFQS1hVDVLb2JzOHdfaFdmNEFad1ZoTEU4M2ZUX0NuQWpGYmVNak10TUJPd2l5Z3BUY3hpTGZYZFZLVnVVUGRHYzRlOS00RTZLNUI5RkNZY1lxa0RuMW1UZXVRTmFPcU8tLTVnendEc2hCSVJ3a2h3aWZtVldNS01GMDZVcUJ6V0xuTnk0ZjEtYlc2MlNqaWNyeXJ4c19YMDBoSXNJcm9r?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative impasse:</strong> The Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing women’s reservation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lok Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary outreach:</strong> The Union government has initiated formal outreach to Opposition parties to discuss the agenda for a proposed special session of Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rajasthan civic poll results:</strong> Following the recent Rajasthan local body elections, the BJP emerged as the largest party in Jaipur while the Congress made significant gains in Ajmer, with the Prime Minister citing the mandate as support for the party&#x27;s governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQazBMVGFCS2ZNUjhuNjdRcmlydnEzTXpOdmM2NVFOVGMtZmwtNHhmLUZpdUN0UjNiOHl4bzZEMTdBc1pjQWVXR2xZZ3o4RmduRm1ITWJyUXktM2xSY0FBaEM2cWZYQjlTa3NiTjl4SE96WHBRd0ZjWG5GeDJRVUI2c3NWaU43RWZhcEJtWDBKOUUzTldhVzdTeEtFSXJVZEFZaWcyMmZlbk9BM1A2cm9Td2sxblpZR1JI?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Digital safety cooperation:</strong> Meta has reached an agreement to share details regarding Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) with Indian law enforcement agencies to bolster digital security.</li>
